name: service-restart
description: Inspect, restart, enable, or disable a systemd unit (service). Includes status checks and recent unit logs via journalctl.
prompt: Use `systemctl status <unit>` first to see current state and recent failures, then `journalctl -u <unit> -n 50 --no-pager` for context. Restart only after confirming the issue isn't dependency-related; warn the operator about any --now flag side-effects.
examples: 重启一下 docker 服务
